cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(KumweEngine VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
include(CTest)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
option(KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS "Enable AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer" OFF)
option(KUMWE_ENGINE_FUZZ "Build Clang libFuzzer entry point" OFF)
option(KUMWE_ENGINE_BENCHMARKS "Build diagnostic batch benchmark" OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ABI 1 supports 64-bit targets only")
endif()
if(MSVC)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "MSVC/Windows is not yet a supported development target")
endif()
include(cmake/Pcre2.cmake)
add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Werror -fstack-protector-strong)
if(KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS)
  add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
set(ENGINE_SOURCES src/abi.cpp src/batch.cpp src/decimal/decimal.cpp src/value/json.cpp src/vm/decimal.cpp src/vm/formula.cpp src/document/document.cpp src/document/normalized_value.cpp src/document/computed_value.cpp src/document/unicode_normalization.cpp src/document/preparation.cpp src/document/validators.cpp src/plan/plan.cpp src/reporting/report.cpp src/reporting/converted.cpp src/value/php_numeric.cpp src/canonical/canonical.cpp src/canonical/sha256.cpp)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/capabilities.json" ENGINE_CAPABILITIES)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/abi-manifest.json" ENGINE_ABI_MANIFEST)
string(JSON ENGINE_ABI_MAJOR GET "${ENGINE_ABI_MANIFEST}" abi_major)
string(JSON ENGINE_ABI_MINOR GET "${ENGINE_ABI_MANIFEST}" abi_minor)
string(JSON ENGINE_ABI_FILE_COUNT LENGTH "${ENGINE_ABI_MANIFEST}" files)
if(NOT ENGINE_ABI_MAJOR EQUAL 1 OR NOT ENGINE_ABI_MINOR EQUAL 0 OR NOT ENGINE_ABI_FILE_COUNT EQUAL 4)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected ABI 1 manifest version or source closure")
endif()
foreach(ABI_FILE include/kumwe/engine/engine.h resources/abi-symbols.txt resources/abi-symbols.map docs/abi.md)
  string(JSON ABI_EXPECTED_HASH GET "${ENGINE_ABI_MANIFEST}" files "${ABI_FILE}")
  file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${ABI_FILE}" ABI_ACTUAL_HASH)
  if(NOT ABI_EXPECTED_HASH STREQUAL ABI_ACTUAL_HASH)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ABI manifest hash mismatch: ${ABI_FILE}")
  endif()
endforeach()
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/abi-manifest.json" ENGINE_ABI_MANIFEST_DIGEST)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/definition/formula-v1.json" ENGINE_FORMULA_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/document-profile-v1.json" ENGINE_DOCUMENT_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/preparation-v1.json" ENGINE_PREPARATION_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/reporting/materialization-v1.json" ENGINE_REPORT_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/canonical/generic-v1.json" ENGINE_CANONICAL_CORPUS)
# Bind runtime identity to source closure and the selected target/compiler recipe.
file(GLOB_RECURSE ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  "src/*" "include/*" "cmake/*" "corpus/*" "resources/*" "third_party/*")
list(APPEND ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES CMakeLists.txt docs/abi.md)
list(SORT ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES})
set(ENGINE_IDENTITY "kumwe-engine-build/v2")
foreach(RECIPE_FIELD CMAKE_VERSION CMAKE_C_COMPILER CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID CMAKE_C_COMPILER_VERSION
    CMAKE_C_COMPILER_TARGET CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION
    CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_TARGET CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR CMAKE_SYSROOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE
    CMAKE_C_FLAGS CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO CMAKE_C_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
    CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
    CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION
    KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS KUMWE_ENGINE_FUZZ)
  string(LENGTH "${${RECIPE_FIELD}}" RECIPE_VALUE_LENGTH)
  string(APPEND ENGINE_IDENTITY "|${RECIPE_FIELD}:${RECIPE_VALUE_LENGTH}:${${RECIPE_FIELD}}")
endforeach()
foreach(IDENTITY_FILE IN LISTS ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES)
  file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${IDENTITY_FILE}" IDENTITY_HASH)
  string(APPEND ENGINE_IDENTITY "|${IDENTITY_FILE}:${IDENTITY_HASH}")
endforeach()
string(SHA256 ENGINE_BUILD_DIGEST "${ENGINE_IDENTITY}")
string(CONFIGURE "${ENGINE_CAPABILITIES}" ENGINE_CAPABILITIES @ONLY)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/capabilities.json" "${ENGINE_CAPABILITIES}")
configure_file(cmake/build_identity.hpp.in generated/build_identity.hpp @ONLY)
add_library(kumwe_engine STATIC ${ENGINE_SOURCES} $<TARGET_OBJECTS:kumwe_pcre2>)
add_library(Kumwe::Engine ALIAS kumwe_engine)
set_target_properties(kumwe_engine PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES EXPORT_NAME Engine)
target_include_directories(kumwe_engine PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}> PRIVATE src "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated" "${PCRE_BINARY}")
target_compile_features(kumwe_engine PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
add_executable(kumwe-engine-conformance cli/conformance.cpp)
target_include_directories(kumwe-engine-conformance PRIVATE tests src)
target_link_libraries(kumwe-engine-conformance PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(unicode-normalization-tests tests/unicode_normalization_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(unicode-normalization-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(unicode-normalization-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME unicode-normalization COMMAND unicode-normalization-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME unicode-data-provenance COMMAND python3 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/generate-unicode-data.py" --check)
  add_executable(canonical-tests tests/canonical_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(canonical-tests PRIVATE src tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
  target_link_libraries(canonical-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME generic-canonical-corpus COMMAND canonical-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/canonical/generic-v1.json")
  add_executable(plan-tests tests/plan_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(plan-tests PRIVATE src tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
  target_link_libraries(plan-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME compiled-plan-ownership COMMAND plan-tests)
  add_executable(report-numeric-tests tests/report_numeric_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(report-numeric-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(report-numeric-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME php-numeric-string-corpus COMMAND report-numeric-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/corpus/report-numeric-v1.json")
  add_executable(report-tests tests/report_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(report-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(report-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME report-materialization-corpus COMMAND report-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/reporting/materialization-v1.json")
  add_executable(preparation-tests tests/preparation_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(preparation-tests PRIVATE src tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
  target_link_libraries(preparation-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-preparation COMMAND preparation-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/preparation-v1.json")
  add_executable(computed-value-tests tests/computed_value_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(computed-value-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(computed-value-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME computed-value-normalization COMMAND computed-value-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/computed-normalization-v1.json")
  add_executable(document-tests tests/document_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(document-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(document-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-batch COMMAND document-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/validation-v1.json")
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-computed-values COMMAND document-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/computed-normalization-v1.json" 86)
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-validator-edges COMMAND document-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/validator-edges-v1.json" 128)
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-values COMMAND document-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/normalized-values-v1.json" 30)
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-validators COMMAND document-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/validator-extension-v1.json" 26)
  add_executable(formula-tests tests/formula_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(formula-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(formula-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME definition-formula-corpus COMMAND formula-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/definition/formula-v1.json")
  add_executable(json-tests tests/json_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(json-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(json-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME lossless-json-transport COMMAND json-tests)
  add_executable(engine-tests tests/engine_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(engine-tests PRIVATE src)
  target_link_libraries(engine-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME behavior-boundary COMMAND engine-tests)
  add_executable(pcre2-policy-test tests/pcre2_policy.c)
  target_include_directories(pcre2-policy-test PRIVATE "${PCRE_BINARY}")
  target_compile_definitions(pcre2-policy-test PRIVATE KUMWE_EXPECTED_PCRE2_JIT=${KUMWE_PCRE2_JIT})
  target_link_libraries(pcre2-policy-test PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  set_target_properties(pcre2-policy-test PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
  add_test(NAME pcre2-target-jit-policy COMMAND pcre2-policy-test)
  add_test(NAME conversion-corpus COMMAND kumwe-engine-conformance "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/decimal/decimal-v1.tsv")
  add_test(NAME diagnostic-cli COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
    "-DCLI=$<TARGET_FILE:kumwe-engine-conformance>"
    "-DTEST_DIRECTORY=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cli-tests"
    "-DCORPUS_DIRECTORY=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus"
    "-DFORMULA_CORPUS=${ENGINE_FORMULA_CORPUS}"
    "-DCANONICAL_CORPUS=${ENGINE_CANONICAL_CORPUS}"
    -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/cli_test.cmake")
  add_executable(c-consumer tests/consumer/main.c)
  target_link_libraries(c-consumer PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  set_target_properties(c-consumer PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
  add_test(NAME plain-c-ownership COMMAND c-consumer)
  add_test(NAME architecture COMMAND bash "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/check-architecture.sh")
  if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    add_library(abi-visibility SHARED ${ENGINE_SOURCES} $<TARGET_OBJECTS:kumwe_pcre2>)
    target_include_directories(abi-visibility PRIVATE include src "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated" "${PCRE_BINARY}")
    set_target_properties(abi-visibility PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES)
    target_link_options(abi-visibility PRIVATE "LINKER:--version-script=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/abi-symbols.map" "LINKER:-z,relro,-z,now")
    # Clang resolves sanitizer runtime from the executable, not this test-only DSO.
    # Production release symbol-link checks retain -z,defs.
    if(NOT KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS)
      target_link_options(abi-visibility PRIVATE "LINKER:-z,defs")
    endif()
    add_test(NAME exported-symbols COMMAND bash "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/check-symbols.sh" "$<TARGET_FILE:abi-visibility>")
    # Build an independently frozen client/header against today's test DSO. Never
    # let the current public include path silently replace its ABI 1 baseline.
    file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/abi-v1/baseline.json" ABI_CLIENT_BASELINE)
    foreach(ABI_CLIENT_FILE tests/abi-v1/include/kumwe/engine/engine.h tests/abi-v1/client.c)
      string(JSON ABI_CLIENT_EXPECTED GET "${ABI_CLIENT_BASELINE}" files "${ABI_CLIENT_FILE}")
      file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${ABI_CLIENT_FILE}" ABI_CLIENT_ACTUAL)
      if(NOT ABI_CLIENT_EXPECTED STREQUAL ABI_CLIENT_ACTUAL)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Frozen ABI client source changed: ${ABI_CLIENT_FILE}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
    add_executable(abi-v1-client tests/abi-v1/client.c)
    target_include_directories(abi-v1-client BEFORE PRIVATE tests/abi-v1/include)
    target_link_libraries(abi-v1-client PRIVATE abi-visibility)
    set_target_properties(abi-v1-client PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
    add_test(NAME oldest-abi-v1-dynamic-client COMMAND abi-v1-client)
  endif()
endif()
if(KUMWE_ENGINE_FUZZ)
  if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libFuzzer requires Clang")
  endif()
  target_compile_options(kumwe_engine PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
  target_link_options(kumwe_engine INTERFACE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
  add_executable(engine-fuzz fuzz/boundary.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(engine-fuzz PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  target_compile_options(engine-fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
  target_link_options(engine-fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
endif()
if(KUMWE_ENGINE_BENCHMARKS)
  add_executable(engine-benchmark benchmarks/decimal_batch.cpp benchmarks/compiled_batch.cpp)
  target_include_directories(engine-benchmark PRIVATE tests src)
  target_compile_definitions(engine-benchmark PRIVATE KUMWE_ENGINE_CORPUS_DIRECTORY="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus")
  target_link_libraries(engine-benchmark PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
endif()
install(TARGETS kumwe_engine EXPORT KumweEngineTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(TARGETS kumwe-engine-conformance RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(EXPORT KumweEngineTargets NAMESPACE Kumwe:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/KumweEngine)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/KumweEngineConfig.cmake.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfig.cmake" INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/KumweEngine)
write_basic_package_version_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfigVersion.cmake" VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY ExactVersion)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfig.cmake" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfigVersion.cmake" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/KumweEngine)
install(FILES third_party/pcre2/LICENCE third_party/php-filter-LICENSE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kumwe-engine/third-party)
install(FILES third_party/unicode/LICENSE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kumwe-engine/third-party/unicode)
install(FILES LICENSE CHARTER.md "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/capabilities.json" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kumwe-engine)
install(FILES resources/abi-manifest.json resources/abi-symbols.txt resources/abi-symbols.map docs/abi.md DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kumwe-engine)
